subject: general
question: Find the perimeter (in cm) of a square having an area equal to the area of a rhombus, measures of whose diagonals are 8 cm and 16 cm.
solution: Given: Measures of the diagonals of the rhombus are 8 cm and 16 cm. Area of the square = Area of the rhombus Concept used: Area of a rhombus = Product of two diagonals ÷ 2 Area of a square = side² Perimeter of a square = 4 × side Calculation:
